integrity: Standalone constructive proof for all finite chain sizes; checker provides exhaustive four-world and smaller experiments and tests the sharp family through twelve worlds. Earlier work is distinguished by hypotheses and exact implication.
scientific_limitations: Fixed labelled finite chains, unrestricted binary accessibility, common upward-closed valuations and pointwise observational equivalence. No claim about frame-validity equivalence, arbitrary posets, or an all-order closed-form count of equivalence classes. First four class totals are exact exhaustive finite results. No independent external audit.
title: Sharp sparse normal form and exact observational fibers for four intuitionistic modalities
